notes.title: City Pack 2 - Adventure
notes.content:
Fellow Voyagers,

We have completed 14 more locations for you to discover. One of which is not even on planet Earth! We hope you enjoy these new locations, added for free to the base game. 

Special Location

We wanted to spice up your travels a bit, so we added The Moon as a location for you to visit. How you'll get there we are leaving for you to figure out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/f637debce4e2aeb8f46cdcb6c0ed3f713bada248.png

Other locations

This time around the keyword is adventure, one such adventurous location being the Galapagos Islands.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/b066a95af75b46c157150610c07dd547947541cb.png

And as it might be cold for you up on the moon, we also included another couple of cold places for you, so you'll feel right at home here on Earth as well: The North Pole, and McMurdo (Antarctica).

It also felt timely to include Kiev, Ukraine in this city pack. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/da2b518c9559629e7b8e105f797425f826b07099.png

Us developers wish for Peace for Ukraine! <3

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/730973e5d8ce8331c99fcee5b4f65dc3af76e289.png

Complete list of new locations:


 Brussels, Belgium
 Cape Canaveral, USA
 Colombo, Sri Lanka
 Galapagos Islands, Ecuador
 Hawaii, USA
 Kathmandu, Nepal
 Kiev, Ukraine
 McMurdo, Antarctica
 Miami, USA
 The Moon
 Nuuk, Greenland
 The North Pole, Arctic
 San Francisco, USA
 Shanghai, China


Safe travels,

Voyager devs

notes.title: City Pack 1
notes.content:
Dear Voyagers,

We have completed a set of new cities for you to visit.

The Nordics

The first add-on is a Nordic package, which completes all capital cities of Scandinavia. In addition to Stockholm in Sweden, now you can also explore Copenhagen in Denmark, Helsinki in Finland, Oslo in Norway, and Reykjavik on Iceland.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/4156b7e395ed9d13a9847ad1a2658a8593ff5fd0.png

Eastern Europe

Furthermore, there have been requests for two other European cities, Sofia in Bulgaria, and Warsaw in Poland. We have added these cities as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38364227/9d4d92ae42a2023910923fc22d4f20ac8ea4643c.png

Available in the base game

Of course, these new cities will be available in the base game, with no additional cost.

The cities are available in English and Swedish, for now. Translation to other languages is not yet complete. If you are playing in Spanish or Portuguese, these new cities will currently default to English.

Expect more content in the future.

Have fun!
